learning_objectives: Define RAG and explain what 'retrieval-augmented' means
Describe the five steps of the RAG pipeline
Explain why RAG is useful compared to a model answering from memory alone
Identify at least two limitations of RAG
central_analogy: An open-book exam — the AI is allowed to look at a textbook before writing its answer, just like a student allowed to use notes
worked_example_scenario: A college exam FAQ chatbot that answers student questions using the official 2024 student handbook

section_plan.note: Relatable scenario of looking up personal notes
Stale knowledge problem + private docs problem
Five numbered steps, one sentence each
Retraining myth, hallucination claim, coverage gap
Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt engineering, fine-tuning

out_of_scope: Specific vector database products (Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
